video_title: Media Availability: Jalen Duren | Pistons TV

quotes.speaker: Jalen Duren
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren addresses false narratives surrounding his character
quotes.excerpt: I'm a professional athlete, but I'm also a son, a big brother, a little brother, a mentor and a leader.
quotes.quote: There has been a lot of talk, speculation, and false narratives around my name throughout the entire summer. So much so that it started to even diminish my character and everything I stand for. Not only am I a professional athlete, but I'm also a son, a big brother, a little brother, a mentor and a leader. I carry those things with pride while understanding the betterment of myself will result in the betterment of others around me as well. So I can acknowledge my flaws, more importantly, embrace them.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Duren addresses the offseason speculation surrounding his name saying there has been a lot of talk and false narratives that started to diminish his character

quotes.speaker: Jalen Duren
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren clarifies his time away from the team
quotes.excerpt: I know everyone here, you, your colleagues and the media have a job to do and I respect that.
quotes.quote: I know everyone here, you, your colleagues and the media have a job to do and I respect that and appreciate your commitment and dedication to your careers. However, I have never spoken to anyone in the media, made any statements or comments about anything or everything that's been out there. So you can accept those as rumors and they do not represent how I feel or what I think. This process took way longer than any of us wanted, longer than I wanted, I'm sure longer than the organization wanted. But they have a job to do as well as my team and my agency have a job to do to make the best outcome possible for both sides, and I feel like we've done that.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Duren clarifies that he has never spoken to the media regarding recent rumors stating those reports do not represent how he feels or what he thinks

quotes.speaker: Jalen Duren
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren on his mental growth during the offseason
quotes.excerpt: I think mentally, I think obviously physically, working on my body, working on my game, staying ready.
quotes.quote: I think mentally, I think obviously physically, working on my body, working on my game, staying ready. But mentally, just understanding the ins and out, and I think I needed this experience to boost my knowledge on this game and the business side. I never looked at it as a bad thing. I never looked at it as a dreadful situation because people are going through way worse. We are talking about negotiating a lot of money and there's no way I could be upset with that. So for me, I just grew my mental, I grew my knowledge of the business side of the game and it really benefited me. I feel like I've come out a better person, a better man and a better player.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Duren says he used the offseason to grow his knowledge of the business side of the game and feels he has come out a better man and player

quotes.speaker: Jalen Duren
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren reaffirms his commitment to the Detroit Pistons
quotes.excerpt: I am a Detroit Piston, I want to be a Detroit Piston for life.
quotes.quote: I am a Detroit Piston, I want to be a Detroit Piston for life. I want to give everything I got for this city and the fans. To the city, I want the city to know that I truly do believe in what we're building. I truly do believe in the players and organization and the coaches that we have, and I want y'all to believe in me and my work ethic and my ability to want to grow as a man and a player.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Duren reaffirms his commitment to the Pistons saying I am a Detroit Piston and I want to be a Detroit Piston for life

quotes.speaker: Jalen Duren
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren discusses the new additions to the Pistons roster
quotes.excerpt: We got some some great shooting with Toryn Prince, Isaiah Joe, John Collins.
quotes.quote: I'm excited, man. I couldn't lie to you. We got some some great shooting with Toryn Prince, Isaiah Joe, John Collins. I've even been able these last couple days kind of get in with these guys and talk to them and kind of get to know them a little bit. But I look forward to it, man. I think we did a great job with just adding to the team and being able to expand our potential.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Duren expresses excitement about the Pistons roster additions noting the team did a great job adding shooting with players like Toryn Prince and John Collins

quotes.speaker: Jalen Duren
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren on his offseason training and game development
quotes.excerpt: I think just tightening up everything, tightening up shot mechanics, working on my body first and foremost.
quotes.quote: I think just tightening up everything, tightening up shot mechanics, working on my body first and foremost, making sure I'm in the best shape possible, being able to get up and down the floor as many times as need be, being able to get out of pick and rolls with speed, being able to jump and move everything I need to be able to do to help this team. It wasn't one specific aspect, I think just my entire game in general, whether that be on both sides of the ball, trying to just become a better player in whole.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Duren on his offseason development saying he focused on tightening his shot mechanics and getting in the best shape possible to help the team
